name: cut like homeobox 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CUX1 encodes homeobox protein cut-like 1 [Cleaved into: CDP/Cux p110]. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); global developmental delay with or without impaired intellectual development (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Glioblastoma; Invasive Breast Carcinoma; Lung Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
